_comment: Playwright MCP config — Khalid runs three monitors (laptop / Dell / Samsung), so a
fixed --viewport-size is wrong: the page would be letter-boxed at one size no matter
which screen the window opens on.
`viewport: null` is the official opt-out. Playwright docs (docs/src/api/params.md):
«Use null to disable the consistent viewport emulation ... making the viewport
depend on the host window size defined by the operating system.»
«no_viewport: Does not enforce fixed viewport, allows resizing window in headed mode.»
Result: the page always fills the real Edge window on whichever screen it lands on,
and it scrolls exactly when the content genuinely does not fit.
every tab (Chromium/Edge flag) so the Network panel is visible during live tests.
Remove this arg when you don't want DevTools popping open on every run.
Changing this file (or .mcp.json) needs a Claude Code reload — MCP reads config at startup.
